title: carex filiformis subsp. aematorhyncha
intro: Carex filiformis subsp. aematorhyncha, commonly known as Slender Tufted Sedge, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Cyperaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Carex filiformis subsp. aematorhyncha include wound healing, anti-diabetic effects, and antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
